messages:
alex: Quick proposal: add a per-tier 'soft_fallback' policy that routes free->pro->enterprise fallbacks with a 'grace_budget' window. Need console UX and telemetry to clearly show when soft fallback kicks in.

maria: Can you sketch the API shape? I worry about exploding combinations.

alex: yeah, thinking minimal and explicit so ops can reason about cost:
```
fallback_policy:
  tiers: [free, pro, enterprise]
  fallback_order:
    - variant: small-quant
      max_latency_ms: 250
    - variant: base
  soft_grace_ms: 15000
  enforcement: soft
```

kevin: soft vs hard enforcement: we must emit metrics for soft hits so PMs/product can see impact. propose: redwood.routing.fallback.rate, redwood.routing.fallback.soft_rate, redwood.quota.soft_rejects. Also include fallback.variant tag.

sara: +1. Dashboard slices: by region + tenant plan + model_variant. p95 latency shift when fallback happens is critical for SLOs.

julian: UX idea: console timeline per-tenant showing when fallback engaged, with a simple knob for 'grace budget' (tokens or ms) and a toggle to auto-notify or auto-escalate a prompt to upgrade. Keep it obvious for support.

kevin: implementation note: router currently picks by priority; add "degradation budget" counter per tenant. Pseudocode:
```
if tenant.degradation_budget > 0 and policy.enforcement == 'soft':
  route_to(fallback_variant)
  tenant.degradation_budget -= token_cost
else:
  enforce_quota()
```

maria: telemetry: include tags fallback.variant and fallback.reason. Also emit event when budget exhausted: redwood.routing.fallback.budget_exhausted. We should tag events with experiment_id for A/B.

alex: ops concern: how to avoid everyone falling to enterprise variants simultaneously and spike enterprise infra? Need cross-tenant smoothing and throttles.

julian: suggest a global reservoir with per-region caps + backpressure signal to console: metric: redwood.routing.fallback.throttle_rate. Console should show global view and per-region breakdown.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-service@staging will get feature-flag 'tiered-soft-fallback' for testing :rocket:

sara: action items:
- kevin: add metrics + event hooks (ETA 2d)
- julian: mock console timeline + knob (ETA 3d)
- alex: update router design doc with pseudocode + safety guards (ETA EOD)

alex: also, prefer very conservative defaults for free tenants so we don't accidentally raise infra costs. default soft_grace_ms = 5000 and variant order should favor quantized smaller models.

maria: agree. add telemetry experiment id to metrics so we can A/B the feature before full rollout.

kevin: will add experiment_id tag and a boolean metric fallback.enabled_in_experiment

alex: I'll write a short RFC after lunch and flag #eng-arch for review. We should include cost sims per-100k requests.

sara: :thumbsup:

kevin: :white_check_mark:
